svg.title: 自己紹介 — about Zolboo
svg.desc: Full-stack developer in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia (UTC+8). Working on semjidkhujirt.com, also building Whistl. Stack: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, C++, React, Next.js, Tailwind, Supabase, HTML, CSS, Git, GitHub, Vercel, VS Code. Contact: otgonbatzolboo@gmail.com, LinkedIn zolboo-otgonbat, Telegram ViuaxZ. Beside the details, two koi circle each other in a dark pool beneath a red sun.
